recipe: Follow the aliasing rules: &T must point to memory that is not mutated while live, and &mut T must be the sole pointer to that memory with no other reference coexisting.
trigger_condition: You are using shared or exclusive references in code that involves mutation or multiple pointer paths.
evidence: &T must point to memory that is not mutated while they are live (except for data inside an UnsafeCell<U>), and &mut T must point to memory that is not read or written by any pointer not derived from the reference and that no other reference points to while they are live.

recipe: Only read uninitialized memory inside unions or in padding (gaps between fields of a type); for any other type with a restricted set of valid values, uninitialized memory is implicitly invalid.
